scenarios.name: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Acute Radiation Shock
scenarios.narrative: During trans-Mars coast, an unpredicted Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) strikes the Orion spacecraft. Ambient radiation surges to 125.0 mGy/h. The astronaut experiences acute radiation sickness, sympathetic neurovascular shock, and sudden circulatory vascular tone collapse.

cockpit_3sec_rapid_dispatch.executive_summary: CRITICAL RED EMERGENCY: Severe Hemodynamic Shock / Cardiovascular Collapse | IMMEDIATE ACTION (T-0): Initiate immediate 1000 mL intravenous saline/electrolyte infusion to restore central venous volume.

open_scientific_and_aerospace_limitation: ASTROVITAL AI computes macroeconomic hemodynamic collapse (Shock Index = 1.919) and orders fluid infusion, but CANNOT quantify cellular DNA double-strand breaks or stochastic chromosomal aberrations in real-time.
Prediction of acute radiation syndrome (ARS) hematopoietic suppression requires ground-based or on-board molecular transcriptomic sequencing not accessible via standard biotelemetry.
Pharmacological radioprotectants (Amifostine/Filgrastim) must be manually retrieved and administered by crew; software cannot automate biological delivery.

scenarios.name: Double Micrometeoroid Puncture + Complete Lead-Off Disconnect
scenarios.narrative: A dual micrometeoroid (MMOD) hypervelocity strike punctures the habitation module. Cabin pressure rapidly plunges to 8.2 psi. Simultaneously, the astronaut's primary ECG lead-wire is physically severed (HR = NaN), while arterial oxygen saturation collapses to 64.0%.

cockpit_3sec_rapid_dispatch.executive_summary: CRITICAL RED EMERGENCY: Cabin Atmosphere Rapid Decompression | IMMEDIATE ACTION (T-0): Don Orion Crew Survival System (OCSS) pressure suit and close helmet visors immediately.
dispatched_equipment_lockers: Forward and Aft Bulkhead Pressure Hatches

open_scientific_and_aerospace_limitation: The DO-178C Mathematical Sanity Gate activates the SensorDecouplingFallbackEngine, estimating heart rate from coupled plethysmography (SpO2 pulse) to prevent pipeline crash.
Open Limitation: If >3 primary physiological transducers undergo concurrent permanent disconnect for >15 consecutive minutes, the system enters 'Degraded Sensor Blind Mode'.
In decompression below 10.5 psi, the algorithm triggers immediate suit donning protocols; however, physical survival strictly depends on mechanical pressure suit integrity and airtight visor lock.

scenarios.name: 360-Day Deep Space SANS Stagnation
scenarios.narrative: After 360 days of continuous zero-g interplanetary transit without exercise countermeasure compliance (Exercise Metric = 0.0), the crew member suffers extreme cephalad fluid redistribution, severe left-ventricular myocardial deconditioning, and chronic intracranial venous congestion.

deterministic_triage_decision.clinical_title: Severe Cephalad Fluid Shift Intracranial Hypertension

cockpit_3sec_rapid_dispatch.executive_summary: CRITICAL RED EMERGENCY: Severe Cephalad Fluid Shift Intracranial Hypertension | IMMEDIATE ACTION (T-0): Initiate emergency Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) suit protocol at -35 mmHg for 45 minutes.

open_scientific_and_aerospace_limitation: The Cephalad Fluid Shift Hydrodynamic Index (I_ICP = 1.95 >= 1.85) mathematically models intracranial venous engorgement from microgravity duration, MAP, and ambient CO2.

Open Limitation: Mathematical I_ICP is a validated biophysical surrogate, but CANNOT physically inspect the posterior ocular globe or grade optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) papilledema without ultrasound or fundoscopy.
Stroke volume collapse (SV = 36.6 mL, >47% loss from baseline 70 mL) requires active resistive preload (ARED) and Chibis LBNP to restore left ventricular mass.

scenarios.name: Lunar EVA In-Helmet Vomiting & Airway Asphyxiation
scenarios.narrative: During a lunar south-pole EVA sortie, astronaut experiences acute Space Motion Sickness (SMS) and vomits inside the pressurized EMU spacesuit helmet. Aspirated vomitus mechanically occludes the upper airway, producing sudden asphyxiation, extreme tachypnea, and desaturation.

cockpit_3sec_rapid_dispatch.executive_summary: CRITICAL RED EMERGENCY: Acute Cardiorespiratory Hypoxic Decompensation | IMMEDIATE ACTION (T-0): Deploy 100% emergency O2 mask immediately via high-pressure rebreather.
dispatched_equipment_lockers: Orion Avionics Console / Suit Umbilical Panel

open_scientific_and_aerospace_limitation: ASTROVITAL AI diagnoses acute hypoxic decompensation within 1.4 milliseconds and commands immediate EVA ABORT and 100% O2 flush.
Open Limitation: Software CANNOT physically extract mechanical vomitus or aspirate particulate matter from the trachea.

Physical buddy-astronaut intervention (carrying victim into airlock, rapid repressurization, unsealing helmet, and endotracheal suctioning) is an absolute non-negotiable physical prerequisite for crew survival.

scenarios.name: Avionics Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) / EMI Blast
scenarios.narrative: A high-power avionic bus arc-fault or solar EMP induces extreme electromagnetic interference across analog bio-transducer harnesses. Raw sensor ADC registers read physically impossible numbers (HR = 650 bpm, SBP = 480 mmHg, Temp = 89.5 C, Cabin Pressure = -12.0 psi).

cockpit_3sec_rapid_dispatch.executive_summary: CRITICAL RED EMERGENCY: Cabin Atmosphere Rapid Decompression | IMMEDIATE ACTION (T-0): Don Orion Crew Survival System (OCSS) pressure suit and close helmet visors immediately.
dispatched_equipment_lockers: Forward and Aft Bulkhead Pressure Hatches

open_scientific_and_aerospace_limitation: DO-178C Mathematical Sanity Gate enforces 100% clamping of all 12 channels to NASA-STD-3001 physical survival caps (HR <= 220, SBP <= 240, Temp <= 42.0 C, Press >= 0.0 psi) without throwing floating-point exceptions or crashing.
Open Limitation: Digital software clamping insulates flight avionics from arithmetic faults, but CANNOT reconstruct true astronaut biological vitals during continuous raw electromagnetic saturation.
Hardened physical Faraday cages, twisted-pair shielded cables, and optical optoisolators are required at the hardware layer to restore valid sensor telemetry.
